data.prometheus.yml:
# KAN-64 bounds: every job inherits a 15s interval / 10s timeout and the global label limits below;
# a scrape that exceeds its sample_limit or a label limit fails as a whole (up=0) instead of
# silently growing the TSDB. Sized for the 2 CPU / 10GiB single-node cluster (2d / 1500MB retention).
global:
  scrape_interval: 15s
  scrape_timeout: 10s
  evaluation_interval: 15s
  label_limit: 20
  label_name_length_limit: 64
  label_value_length_limit: 256
alerting:
  alertmanagers:
    - static_configs:
        - targets: ["alertmanager.liveprobe-observability.svc:9093"]
rule_files:
  - /etc/prometheus/rules/*.yml
scrape_configs:
  - job_name: prometheus
    sample_limit: 3000
    static_configs:
      - targets: ["localhost:9090"]
  # P15: KSM spans all namespaces (Secret collection remains disabled). Only the series
  # the plan needs are ingested: pod phase/readiness/restarts/waiting+terminated reasons (Family 1/2),
  # container limits (Family 2 context), deployment/replicaset replicas and endpoint readiness
  # (Family 1 no-endpoints), node/namespace health. Everything else KSM exposes is dropped.
  - job_name: kube-state-metrics
    sample_limit: 20000
    static_configs:
      - targets: ["kube-state-metrics.liveprobe-observability.svc:8080"]
    metric_relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: [__name__]
        action: keep
        regex: kube_pod_(info|owner|status_phase|status_ready|container_info|container_status_(restarts_total|ready|running|waiting|waiting_reason|terminated|terminated_reason|last_terminated_reason|last_terminated_exitcode|last_terminated_timestamp)|container_resource_(limits|requests))|kube_deployment_(spec_replicas|status_replicas|status_replicas_(available|unavailable|ready|updated)|status_condition|metadata_generation|status_observed_generation)|kube_replicaset_(owner|spec_replicas|status_ready_replicas)|kube_endpoint_(info|address|ports)|kube_service_info|kube_node_(info|status_(condition|capacity|allocatable))|kube_namespace_status_phase
  # P15: all namespace pod/container series plus the root cgroup (node CPU/memory).
  # TLS and nodes/metrics-only authorization remain; retained metric names are bounded.
  - job_name: kubelet-cadvisor
    sample_limit: 20000
    scrape_interval: 15s
    scrape_timeout: 10s
    scheme: https
    metrics_path: /metrics/cadvisor
    tls_config:
      ca_file: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt
    authorization:
      credentials_file: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token
    kubernetes_sd_configs:
      - role: node
    relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_node_address_InternalIP]
        regex: (.+)
        replacement: $1:10250
        target_label: __address__
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_node_name]
        target_label: node
    metric_relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: [namespace, id]
        action: keep
        regex: ".+;.*|;/"
      - source_labels: [__name__]
        action: keep
        regex: container_(cpu_usage_seconds_total|memory_working_set_bytes|memory_rss|spec_memory_limit_bytes|oom_events_total|last_seen)
      - regex: name|image
        action: labeldrop
  - job_name: kubernetes-pods
    sample_limit: 5000
    kubernetes_sd_configs:
      - role: pod
    relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_prometheus_io_scrape]
        action: keep
        regex: "true"
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_phase]
        action: keep
        regex: Running
      # Istio rewrites sidecar pods' scrape annotations to the merged 15020 endpoint.
      # Those Envoy series are collected by envoy-stats (higher label_limit); do not duplicate them.
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_prometheus_io_port]
        action: drop
        regex: "15020"
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_prometheus_io_path]
        action: replace
        target_label: __metrics_path__
        regex: (.+)
      - source_labels: [__address__, __meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_prometheus_io_port]
        action: replace
        regex: ([^:]+)(?::\d+)?;(\d+)
        replacement: $1:$2
        target_label: __address__
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_namespace]
        target_label: namespace
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_name]
        target_label: pod
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_app]
        target_label: app
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_app_kubernetes_io_part_of]
        target_label: system
  # P15: moved from mesh-prometheus; Istio/Envoy remain, Kiali does not.
  - job_name: envoy-stats
    metrics_path: /stats/prometheus
    sample_limit: 20000
    label_limit: 60
    kubernetes_sd_configs:
      - role: pod
    relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_container_port_name]
        action: keep
        regex: ".*-envoy-prom"
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_phase]
        action: keep
        regex: Running
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_namespace]
        target_label: namespace
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_name]
        target_label: pod
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_uid]
        target_label: pod_uid
    metric_relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: [__name__]
        action: keep
        regex: istio_requests_total|istio_request_duration_milliseconds_(bucket|sum|count)|envoy_listener_manager_lds_update_rejected
      # Keep the established request series on their original label sets.
      - source_labels: [__name__]
        regex: istio_requests_total|istio_request_duration_milliseconds_(bucket|sum|count)
        target_label: pod_uid
        replacement: ""
data.recording.yml:
groups:
  - name: liveprobe-target-recording
    interval: 30s
    rules:
      - record: liveprobe:http_server_requests:rate1m
        expr: |
          sum by (namespace, app, status) (
            rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{namespace=~"liveprobe-target|dev|prd", app=~"inventory|order|catalog|member|payment|notification|delivery"}[1m])
          )
      - record: liveprobe:http_server_requests_5xx:ratio_rate1m
        expr: |
          sum by (namespace, app) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{namespace=~"liveprobe-target|dev|prd", app=~"inventory|order|catalog|member|payment|notification|delivery", status=~"5.."}[1m]))
          /
          sum by (namespace, app) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{namespace=~"liveprobe-target|dev|prd", app=~"inventory|order|catalog|member|payment|notification|delivery"}[1m]))
      - record: liveprobe:http_server_requests_latency_seconds:avg_rate1m
        expr: |
          sum by (namespace, app) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_sum{namespace=~"liveprobe-target|dev|prd", app=~"inventory|order|catalog|member|payment|notification|delivery", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[1m]))
          /
          sum by (namespace, app) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{namespace=~"liveprobe-target|dev|prd", app=~"inventory|order|catalog|member|payment|notification|delivery", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[1m]))
      - record: liveprobe:hikaricp_connections:utilization
        expr: |
          max by (namespace, app, pool) (hikaricp_connections_active{namespace=~"liveprobe-target|dev|prd"})
          /
          max by (namespace, app, pool) (hikaricp_connections_max{namespace=~"liveprobe-target|dev|prd"})
      # Per-container ratio where cAdvisor exposes container="..." series; otherwise (live on
      # rancher-desktop/k3s, KAN-64 evidence 2026-09-27: only pod-level cgroup series, no
      # container label) fall back to the pod-level ratio for pods without a container series.
      - record: liveprobe:container_memory_working_set:ratio_limit
        expr: |
          (
            max by (namespace, pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"liveprobe-target|dev|prd", container!=""})
            /
            max by (namespace, pod, container) (container_spec_memory_limit_bytes{namespace=~"liveprobe-target|dev|prd", container!=""} > 0)
          )
          or on (namespace, pod)
          (
            max by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"liveprobe-target|dev|prd", container=""})
            /
            max by (namespace, pod) (container_spec_memory_limit_bytes{namespace=~"liveprobe-target|dev|prd", container=""} > 0)
          )
      - record: liveprobe:kube_pod_container_restarts:increase5m
        expr: |
          sum by (namespace, pod, container) (
            increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"liveprobe-target|dev|prd"}[5m])
          )
      - record: liveprobe:kube_deployment_replicas_unavailable
        expr: |
          max by (namespace, deployment) (kube_deployment_status_replicas_unavailable{namespace=~"liveprobe-target|dev|prd"})
  - name: p18-business-route-latency
    interval: 15s
    rules:
      - record: liveprobe:http_business_route_slow_requests:increase1m
        expr: |
          clamp_min(sum by (namespace, app, method, uri) (increase(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"dev|prd", app=~"inventory|order|catalog|member|payment|notification|delivery", method=~"GET|POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE|HEAD|OPTIONS", uri=~"/api/[A-Za-z0-9_./{}-]{1,145}", le="+Inf"}[1m])) - sum by (namespace, app, method, uri) (increase(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"dev|prd", app=~"inventory|order|catalog|member|payment|notification|delivery", method=~"GET|POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE|HEAD|OPTIONS", uri=~"/api/[A-Za-z0-9_./{}-]{1,145}", le="0.5"}[1m])), 0)
          and on (namespace, app, method, uri) (sum by (namespace, app, method, uri) (increase(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"dev|prd", app=~"inventory|order|catalog|member|payment|notification|delivery", method=~"GET|POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE|HEAD|OPTIONS", uri=~"/api/[A-Za-z0-9_./{}-]{1,145}", le="+Inf"}[1m])) >= 3)
data.alerts.yml:
groups:
- name: liveprobe-target
  rules:
  - alert: TargetWorkloadImagePullFailing
    expr: "max by (namespace, pod, container, reason) (\n  kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{namespace=\"\
      liveprobe-target\", reason=~\"ImagePullBackOff|ErrImagePull\"}\n) > 0\n"
    for: 0s
    labels:
      severity: warning
    annotations:
      summary: Container {{ $labels.container }} in {{ $labels.pod }} cannot pull
        its image ({{ $labels.reason }})
  - alert: TargetServiceNoEndpoints
    expr: "(\n  count by (namespace, endpoint) (kube_endpoint_info{namespace=\"liveprobe-target\"\
      })\n  unless\n  count by (namespace, endpoint) (kube_endpoint_address{namespace=\"\
      liveprobe-target\", ready=\"true\"})\n)\n"
    for: 10m
    labels:
      severity: critical
    annotations:
      summary: Service {{ $labels.endpoint }} has no ready endpoints
  - alert: OrderHigh5xxRate
    expr: "sum by (namespace, app) (\n  rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{namespace=\"\
      liveprobe-target\", app=\"order\", status=~\"5..\"}[1m])\n) > 0.1\n"
    for: 30s
    labels:
      severity: critical
    annotations:
      summary: order is returning 5xx ({{ $value | printf "%.2f" }}/s)
  - alert: TargetWorkloadCrashLooping
    expr: "max by (namespace, pod, container) (\n  kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{namespace=\"\
      liveprobe-target\", reason=\"CrashLoopBackOff\"}\n) > 0\n"
    for: 30s
    labels:
      severity: critical
    annotations:
      summary: Container {{ $labels.container }} in {{ $labels.pod }} is crash-looping
  - alert: TargetWorkloadOOMKilled
    expr: "max by (namespace, pod, container) (\n  kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace=\"\
      liveprobe-target\", reason=\"OOMKilled\"}\n) > 0\n"
    for: 0s
    labels:
      severity: critical
    annotations:
      summary: Container {{ $labels.container }} in {{ $labels.pod }} was OOMKilled
  - alert: TargetHighLatency
    expr: 'liveprobe:http_server_requests_latency_seconds:avg_rate1m{namespace="liveprobe-target",
      app=~"order|inventory"} > 0.5

      '
    for: 0s
    labels:
      severity: warning
    annotations:
      summary: '{{ $labels.app }} mean request latency exceeded 500ms'
  - alert: TargetConnectionPoolExhausted
    expr: 'liveprobe:hikaricp_connections:utilization{namespace="liveprobe-target",
      app="inventory"} >= 0.95

      '
    for: 0s
    labels:
      severity: critical
    annotations:
      summary: '{{ $labels.app }} database connection pool is exhausted'
  - alert: InventoryHigh5xxRate
    expr: "sum by (namespace, app) (\n  rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{namespace=\"\
      liveprobe-target\", app=\"inventory\", status=~\"5..\"}[1m])\n) > 0.1\n"
    for: 0s
    labels:
      severity: critical
    annotations:
      summary: inventory is returning 5xx ({{ $value | printf "%.2f" }}/s)
- name: p18-environments
  rules:
  - alert: TargetHigh5xxRate
    expr: ((sum by (namespace, app, method, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{namespace=~"dev|prd",
      app=~"inventory|order|catalog|member|payment|notification|delivery", method=~"GET|POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE|HEAD|OPTIONS",
      uri=~"/api/[A-Za-z0-9_./{}-]{1,145}", status=~"5.."}[1m])) > 0) or on (namespace,
      app) sum by (namespace, app) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{namespace=~"dev|prd",
      app=~"inventory|order|catalog|member|payment|notification|delivery", status=~"5..",
      uri=~"/api/.*"}[1m]))) and on (namespace, app) (sum by (namespace, app) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{namespace=~"dev|prd",
      app=~"inventory|order|catalog|member|payment|notification|delivery", status=~"5..",
      uri=~"/api/.*"}[1m])) > 0.04)
    for: 15s
    labels:
      severity: critical
      liveprobe_scope: p18
    annotations:
      summary: '{{ $labels.app }} business requests are returning 5xx'
  - alert: TargetHighLatency
    expr: liveprobe:http_server_requests_latency_seconds:avg_rate1m{namespace=~"dev|prd",
      app=~"inventory|order|catalog|member|payment|notification|delivery"} > 0.5
    for: 0s
    labels:
      severity: warning
      liveprobe_scope: p18
    annotations:
      summary: '{{ $labels.app }} mean response time exceeded 500ms'
  - alert: TargetRouteSlowRequests
    expr: liveprobe:http_business_route_slow_requests:increase1m{namespace=~"dev|prd"}
      >= 3
    for: 0s
    labels:
      severity: warning
      liveprobe_scope: p18
    annotations:
      summary: '{{ $labels.app }} {{ $labels.method }} {{ $labels.uri }} has repeated
        requests above 500ms'
  - alert: TargetProxyListenerUpdateRejected
    expr: max by (namespace,pod,pod_uid) (increase(envoy_listener_manager_lds_update_rejected{job="envoy-stats",namespace=~"dev|prd",pod_uid=~".+"}[2m])
      > 0 and envoy_listener_manager_lds_update_rejected{job="envoy-stats",namespace=~"dev|prd",pod_uid=~".+"}
      and on (namespace,pod,pod_uid,instance) (up{job="envoy-stats",namespace=~"dev|prd",pod_uid=~".+"}
      == 1))
    for: 0s
    labels:
      severity: warning
      liveprobe_scope: p18
    annotations:
      summary: '{{ $labels.pod }} rejected an Envoy listener update. Route impact
        is unobserved.'
  - alert: TargetConnectionPoolExhausted
    expr: liveprobe:hikaricp_connections:utilization{namespace=~"dev|prd"} >= 0.95
    for: 0s
    labels:
      severity: critical
      liveprobe_scope: p18
    annotations:
      summary: '{{ $labels.app }} connection pool is exhausted'
  - alert: TargetWorkloadCrashLooping
    expr: max by (namespace,pod,container) (kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{namespace=~"dev|prd",reason="CrashLoopBackOff"})
      > 0
    for: 15s
    labels:
      severity: critical
      liveprobe_scope: p18
    annotations:
      summary: '{{ $labels.container }} is crash-looping'
  - alert: TargetWorkloadOOMKilled
    expr: max by (namespace,pod,container) ((kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace=~"dev|prd",reason="OOMKilled"}
      > 0) and on (namespace,pod,uid,container) (time() - kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_timestamp{namespace=~"dev|prd"}
      >= 0 and time() - kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_timestamp{namespace=~"dev|prd"}
      < 120))
    for: 0s
    labels:
      severity: critical
      liveprobe_scope: p18
    annotations:
      summary: '{{ $labels.container }} was OOMKilled'
  - alert: TargetWorkloadImagePullFailing
    expr: max by (namespace,pod,container,reason) (kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{namespace=~"dev|prd",reason=~"ImagePullBackOff|ErrImagePull"})
      > 0
    for: 0s
    labels:
      severity: warning
      liveprobe_scope: p18
    annotations:
      summary: '{{ $labels.container }} cannot pull its image'
  - alert: TargetServiceNoEndpoints
    expr: count by (namespace,endpoint) (kube_endpoint_info{namespace=~"dev|prd"})
      unless count by (namespace,endpoint) (kube_endpoint_address{namespace=~"dev|prd",ready="true"})
    for: 10m
    labels:
      severity: critical
      liveprobe_scope: p18
    annotations:
      summary: '{{ $labels.endpoint }} has no ready endpoints'
